title: Hover inspect card is never clamped to the viewport or tray band — edge nodes render the traceability numbers off-screen
detail: At the 1280×720 design grid the map (40×30 tiles @26px) fills the window vertically (view_compute: scale=min(1280/1040,720/780)=0.923, off_y=0). A node on bottom row 29 anchors its 232×52 card at screen y≈708 — both text lines (y+26, y+42) land below 720. Right-column nodes clip ~65px.
recommended_fix: Clamp the card like popover_rect: flip left when x+232 exceeds win_w, clamp y into [8, win_h−TRAY_CLEAR−52]. Reuse or mirror popover_rect's geometry helper for entity-anchored panels.

title: Stuck-pile measurement predicate is duplicated between warning_evaluate and node_health_measure instead of being one shared helper
detail: The same stuck-packet rule (delivered/on_edge/waiting_ticks>=1, bandwidth sum) is written twice. Future edits to one copy silently diverge health from the 4.1 strain; coherence rests on the test, not shared construction.
recommended_fix: Extract the stuck-load accumulation into one shared core helper (e.g. node_stuck_units(flow, topo, cat, slot) or a single-pass accumulator) called by both warning_evaluate and node_health_measure.
